personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines, repeats methods that have worked before, and is cautious about unfamiliar ideas. At the same time, they are often disorganized and inconsistent with planning, so they may forget details or let tasks slip if there is no immediate pressure. In moral dilemmas, they usually try to stay fair and cooperative, but they will firmly defend their own view when they think a principle matters. In group discussions, they are reserved and speak in a measured way, usually contributing more in small or quiet settings than in large, fast-moving ones. When stressed, they may become tense or withdrawn for a time, though they generally recover without becoming overwhelmed.
